name: padezhnov
description: Claude Code mods by Evgeny Padezhnov.

plugins.name: unattended
plugins.description: Resume on your own after a usage-limit reset, and stop the agent burning the new window on the same failing call.

plugins.name: anti-slop
plugins.description: Fewer narrating comments and stock phrases: nudges Claude right after a comment-heavy edit; keeps "load-bearing" and "You're absolutely right" out of replies.

plugins.name: native-edits
plugins.description: File changes through Edit and Write, not sed -i and heredocs: rewrites auto mode's shell-first advice and refuses Bash commands that write project files, so every change has a diff and can be rewound.
